name: com.michaelo.oxgframe
description: The OxGFrame is a framework based on Unity for accelerating game development. Supports multi-platform Win, OSX, Android, iOS, WebGL.

samples.description: Agent Skill (SKILL.md + source-verified references) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to develop with OxGFrame; briefly covers the OxGKit APIs used by the framework. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import.

Editor-only build pipeline extension for CI/CLI. Chains HybridCLR install and generation, hotfix DLL compile-and-copy, YooAsset bundle builds driven by a bundle-map JSON, config export, and the player build (BuildTool.BuildApp / BuildBundles).

The in-scene audio manager prefab with the MasterMixer asset (BGM/General/Interact/Voice/Atmosphere groups, snapshots, and exposed volume parameters). Required by the MediaFrames.AudioFrame mixer APIs.

The required bootstrap prefab for all bundle-driven features. Configures play mode (EditorSimulate/Offline/Host/WeakHost/WebGL/Custom), preset app and DLC packages, download options, and decryption settings. Gate startup with AssetPatcher.IsInitialized().

Demonstrates the HybridCLR hotfix flow with Hotfixers.CheckHotfix: main/hotfix assembly split (two asmdefs), AOT metadata and hotfix DLL loading, hotfix events with user retry, then entering the hotfix scene. Requires the PatchLauncher prefab.

Demonstrates the full patch flow with AssetPatcher.Check: patch FSM state events, group-selection download confirm, progress and speed display, repair, then asset load/unload via AssetLoaders. Requires the PatchLauncher prefab.

Demonstrates independent per-DLC-package patching with PackageOperation: create operations, listen to grouped events, then Ready/Begin/Repair/Cancel per DLC package. Requires the PatchLauncher prefab.

Demonstrates CoreFrames.UIFrame: asset-name constants with group ids, Show/Close/Hide/Reveal/Preload, data passing, awaiting (loading) UI, stack-by-stack ESC-menu pattern, UICanvas setup, auto mask, and the full UIBase lifecycle with CodeBinding (_Node@).
Demonstrates CoreFrames.SRFrame for scene-resource prefabs (SRBase): Show with parent, generic Show and GetComponent access, Hide/Reveal, CloseAll variants, and collector node binding.

Demonstrates CoreFrames.USFrame scene management: Build Settings scenes (build# prefix) vs bundled scenes, single/additive loading with progression callbacks, activating scene root game objects, and Unload. Bundled scenes require the PatchLauncher prefab.
Demonstrates CoreFrames.CPFrame clone prefabs (CPBase): LoadWithClone and LoadWithCloneAsync, the factory-method pattern, and tilde node binding (~Node@) for cells and repeated prefabs.

Demonstrates MediaFrames.AudioFrame: audio prefab constants by SoundType category, Play/Stop/Pause/ResumeAll, playing with a runtime AudioClip, and AudioMixer control (snapshots and exposed parameters). Requires the AudioManager prefab.
Demonstrates MediaFrames.VideoFrame: RenderTexture vs Camera render modes, GetTargetRenderTexture with RawImage, SetEndEvent, playback speed control, and SkipToPercent.

Demonstrates the GSIFrame game-stage flow: a GSIManagerBase singleton registering stages in its constructor, DriveStart/DriveUpdate from a driver MonoBehaviour, and deferred or forced stage switching.

Demonstrates NetFrame network clients: NetNode setup with response handlers and heartbeat/out-receive/reconnect tickers, WebSocket/TCP/KCP providers and options, INetTips connection feedback, and NetFrames Connect/Send/Close.
Demonstrates the CenterFrame APICenter: a CenterBase registry of APIBase classes, Find access from anywhere, and HTTP requests via the built-in Http.Acax and AcaxAsync helpers.
Demonstrates the CenterFrame EventCenter: a CenterBase registry of EventBase classes with the Emit/HandleEvent/Release pattern for decoupled cross-system events.
